title: The Signature Naming Philosophy - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. A name is a small machine with three moving parts: sound that survives being shouted across a room, meaning that survives being explained in one sentence, and lineage that survives being asked 'where did that come from'. If any part is missing, the name goes back to the forge. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: The Signature Name-Forge - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. The Name-Forge is the working method behind every Signature name: gather seed words, shape syllables, test the sound aloud, fix one meaning, tag the lineage, run the validation checklist. The forge log is kept with the name so anyone can see how it was made. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Personal Names - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. A Signature personal name is built for one bearer: a given name chosen for its meaning plus a lineage name that records descent. Both glosses ride with the name in its record, so the name is self-explaining wherever it appears. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Family-Style Names - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. Signature family-style names work like surnames but are earned or chosen rather than inherited: they may record a craft, a place, or a founding story. The record states which, in plain words. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Brand Names - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. Signature brand names are forged, not found: clarity first, sayability second, collision check third. Every brand name in the Signature line carries its forging notes — what it was built to say and what it was checked against. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Product-Line Naming - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. A Signature product line names its children on a skeleton: family word, model word, edition number. The family word is permanent, the model word describes what changed, the number counts editions. No product ships with a name that breaks the skeleton. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Place Names - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. Signature place names are built landform-first: the ground's shape plus the story of the place, in that order. Invented places are labeled invented on the same line as the name. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Project Codenames - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. Signature codenames are short, pronounceable, and meaningless on purpose — they identify a project without describing it, so a leaked codename leaks nothing. The real name is filed separately when the project goes public. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Names for the Million-File March - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. As the databases march toward a million records, Signature naming keeps the archive navigable: one naming skeleton per database family, edition marks on everything, and no two databases sharing a slug. The naming system scales because it was designed to. Signature original — not a public record.

title: Signature Name Porting Across Languages - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. When a Signature name crosses into another language, the meaning is ported first and the sound reshaped second, with source and port recorded side by side. A port that loses the meaning is a new name, not a translation, and is filed as one. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Lineage and Edition Marks - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. Every Signature name carries two tags: lineage (what it descends from) and edition (public or Signature). The tags are part of the record, not decoration — they are how the archive tells an original from a borrowing at a glance. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Naming Taboos - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. The forge refuses: copying a living person's full name, dressing a joke as a formal name, borrowing sacred names as decoration, and filing any name the filer cannot gloss in one sentence. Taboos are enforced by the validation checklist, not by taste. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Sound Patterns - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. Signature names favor two-beat and three-beat rhythms with open vowels and clean consonant edges. The pattern is tested by reading the name aloud twice — if it stumbles the second time, the syllables are reshaped. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: Signature Meaning Ledger - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. Every Signature name's meaning is entered in the ledger in plain words, one line per name. The ledger is the check against drift: if the meaning on file and the meaning in use ever disagree, the record is corrected, never the memory. Signature original — not a public record.
provenance: Signature original - created for the JAH Databases Signature edition and clearly labeled Signature; not a public record.

title: The Signature Master Name Index - Signature master names reference
description: Signature original. The master index is the map of all Signature names: every name, its meaning, its lineage, its edition mark, in one searchable list. New names are checked against the index before filing, so no two Signature names collide. Signature original — not a public record.
